object_overviews.location: Constitution Avenue & 18th Street NW, Washington, D.C.
object_overviews.subject_bio: Artigas was a military and political leader in the independence struggles of the Río de la Plata. He advocated federalism and regional autonomy and became a foundational figure in Uruguay's national history.
object_overviews.image_alt: Statue of General José Gervasio Artigas holding a hat
